chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves the trustworthy worker.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام, Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْمُحْتَرِفَ: one who works in a profession or trade

ai.seo_question: Does Allah love a person who works honestly and earns through a trustworthy profession?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves a person who earns a living through work while maintaining trustworthiness. It highlights honesty and integrity in one’s profession as a spiritually valued quality.
